HeroList.Name: Lantern Knight
HeroList.Description: A keyblade-bearing pioneer. Travel to charge a lantern pulse; build a bustling brigade.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Nearby friends' basic attacks kindle the lamp (one spark per 0.25s). At 8 sparks, up to four friends join a finite-budget lantern advance under its light. Stay within 4 units to gather sparks. Alone, your own attacks light it. Approach: a focused line, a wide fan, or a protective circle that also snuffs one hostile shot.

HeroList.Name: Postmaster
HeroList.Description: A wandering parcel launcher. Collected gold charges automatic express volleys.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Basic hits stamp up to three different enemies for 6s. Every third personal attack delivers parcels to the stamped addresses; homing parcels share 90% weapon damage. Choose express parcels, fragile ember packages, or a linking relay. Without a stamp, the next target receives the delivery.

HeroList.Name: Drowsy Seer
HeroList.Description: A sleepy tuning-bell oracle. Stand still to chill nearby threats and erase a few hostile bullets.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Attacking and walking fill 4 dream sparks. When they are full, pause for half a second (or keep going for 3s) and a dream of you stays behind, waiting where you were; it attacks from there for 4s while you move on. Rest healing remains. Choose a focused dream, a spreading dream, or a chilling dream. One dream at a time; no extra body in the roster.

HeroList.Name: The Root Oracle
HeroList.Description: Stationary in combat. Whole-arena pickup and a slowing ward. Walks in shops.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Rooted in battle, with three planted roots around you. Every 3s an occupied root attacks or shelters you. Roots can catch a hostile shot in Shelter, rake a line in Thorns, or trade some attack power for recovery in Harvest. You still walk normally in shops.

HeroList.Name: The Lone Jelly
HeroList.Description: Travels without roster companions; absorbs purchased companions' traits. Strong attacks and natural recovery support relic-focused builds.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Equipped memories become three rotating organs. Every third attack expresses the next organ: a bite, a frost gland, or a stitched limb based on the memory's traits. Select memories in the shop; all previously absorbed passive traits remain. With no memory, the mouth supplies a short bite.

HeroList.Name: Lady Loaded Dice
HeroList.Description: Collect 6 gold to burst nearby enemies. High luck and critical chance; low health.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Collect 6 gold to play the visible next die face, with a once every 4s. Faces cast darts, a cross, frost, a coin, healing, or a jackpot. The next face follows a visible six-face sequence. In shops, pay 6 gold to reroll the starting face once per wave. Approach changes the geometry of damage faces.

HeroList.Name: The Tide Singer
HeroList.Description: Collect 8 gold to heal 3 health and push nearby enemies back.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Every 3 coin pickups mix a tide, at most once per 4s. Every two drinks bought add an extra note, up to three. Choose an aimed current, a restorative shore, or a breaking wave. The restorative shore heals 3 HP; ordinary enemies may be pushed, bosses stay anchored.

HeroList.Name: The Comet Courier
HeroList.Description: Travel 10 units to release a slowing pulse. Moving charges it; shops do not.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Travel 10 world units to ignite the last three points of your route as a delayed wake. Your path determines its shape. Choose a narrow trail, parallel crescents, or a closed loop. Damage is shared across the whole wake; shops and pauses cannot charge it.

HeroList.Name: The Mirror Keeper
HeroList.Description: Stand still for 2 seconds to reflect up to 3 nearby bullets. Moving resets charge.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Nothing is taken, only borrowed: the mirror catches a hostile shot that comes within 1 unit of you (2 units after you stand still for half a second), one every 2s, up to three. Your next basic attack returns them, or they return after 2s. Each returned shot carries 60% W. Choose an aimed fan, reverse trajectories, or a ring.

HeroList.Name: The Treasure Clerk
HeroList.Description: Every 10 collected gold grants 1 extra gold and a small healing pulse.
HeroList.SkillDescription: A visible bounty marks one enemy. Basic hits put stamps on it; three stamps settle the claim even against a boss. A kill also settles it. Claims pay 1 gold (maximum 8 per wave) and send a bounded archive strike. Choose the closest threat, a ranged threat, or the richest-health target.

HeroList.Name: Copper Cauldron
HeroList.Description: Start with +8 contact damage. Each Morning Bells activation gives +0.15 armor. Taking damage adds 0.15 regeneration for this run. Enemies move 10% faster.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Nearby enemies build steam; taking an ordinary hit adds two steam. At 6 steam, vent a directional jet. Lid catches a nearby bullet, Boil makes a wide cone, and Whistle draws a long steam line. Hunger and other health costs do not fuel the kettle.

HeroList.Name: China Marionette
HeroList.Description: Healing is 2.5 times as effective, but armor starts 0.25 lower. Each Wild Stitch activation adds 0.4 regeneration. Taking damage adds 1 contact damage.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Every crack becomes a piece: each ordinary injury, and every 6 HP actually recovered, grows a porcelain shard (up to three). An attack spends one shard on a delayed counterpiece. Choose a needle, a broken mirror, or a sheltering stitch. Sheltering stitches heal 1 HP but cannot grow another shard from their own healing.

HeroList.Name: Soap Skater
HeroList.Description: Ordinary attacks deal 35% less damage. Push ordinary enemies harder, within the push cap. Each Clockwork Union activation adds 4 wave income. Treasure +20%.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Changing travel direction by at least 55 degrees while moving leaves a bubble, at most once per 1.2s. Bubbles pop after a short warning, slowing or gently pushing ordinary enemies. Three recent turns form a larger pattern. Choose a ribbon, a fountain, or a round bubble.

HeroList.Name: Velvet Regent
HeroList.Description: You do not attack. Your personal damage, attack speed, critical chance and projectile bonuses also help allies. Shops may sell evolved companions. More enemies appear.
HeroList.SkillDescription: You never attack yourself. Six allied basic attacks prepare a command, at most once per 4s. Spear selects the closest enemy, Volley favors ranged enemies, and Court favors the toughest enemy. Up to three friends perform their own weapon-shaped responses, sharing one budget. Your choice also changes friend target priorities.

HeroList.Name: Button Cavalier
HeroList.Description: Start with 35% dodge and 35% less HP. Dodge cap: 75%. Dodges add treasure detection for this run. Toy Knights deal 30% more damage.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Answer every discourtesy with a bow: a near miss gives 1 poise, a dodge 2, and an ordinary blow that lands on you 1. Each bullet can grant poise once; near misses have a 0.8s shared cooldown. At 3 poise, your next attack makes a precise riposte. Choose a thrust, a sweeping guard, or a crossed salute.

HeroList.Name: Night Maw
HeroList.Description: Lose 1 HP each second in battle. Each enemy defeated heals 1 HP. Regeneration and hearts do not heal. Every fourth wave raises everyone's movement speed.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Kills feed the mouth. Three meals prepare a bite against nearby enemies, with a once every 2.5s. Choose a focused bite, a sweeping jaw, or a rear maw. Hunger and kill healing remain; bosses cannot be swallowed or instantly executed.

HeroList.Name: Thorn Treasurer
HeroList.Description: Dream shops follow the shared 3-4-wave schedule. At wave start, maximum HP follows saved gold (20–400). Buying a spiked relic recruits a Bristle Ball. Team damage -20%.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Saved gold gives up to four collateral thorns at wave start (one per 30 gold). Each ordinary injury spends one thorn to answer with a directed thorn pattern; no gold is secretly spent. Basic attacks regrow one thorn every four attacks, and a full crown spends one by itself on an enemy that comes within 2.5 units. Choose lances, a crown, or a crossed receipt. Your gold-based HP and dream-shop rule remain.

HeroList.Name: Citrus Marshal
HeroList.Description: You do not attack. Move 20% faster and gain 50% HP. Allies stay close; contact damage scales with your movement speed. Team attack speed -25%.
HeroList.SkillDescription: You fight alongside the moving convoy you lead. Friends follow alternating lanes behind your heading, with their existing speed limits. Travel 8 units to peel a short path of contact bursts. Choose a narrow escort, a wide procession, or a close circle. Static-follower relics and pony mounts keep their own rules.

HeroList.Name: Ivory Sovereign
HeroList.Description: Start each wave with 18 royal health. Each injury consumes exactly 1 royal health and releases a short retaliation. Ordinary healing cannot refill it. Velvet Court allies gain a projectile.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Your 18 royal HP and one-HP injuries remain. Every injury writes a decree toward a threat; every third personal basic attack writes another. Decrees take the shape of a verdict line, a court seal, or a crossed sentence. Retaliation is delayed and has a 1s shared cooldown; health costs do not write decrees.

HeroList.Name: Petal Citadel
HeroList.Description: Start each wave with a balanced blessing: +2 flat melee and ranged damage, +10 HP, +5% speed and +0.15 armor.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Different owned relics nourish four petals: attack, guard, healing, and projectile. Duplicate copies do not add petal levels. Every fourth attack blooms the garden. Its geometry and recovery depend on which petals have grown; a complete garden opens an extra outer bloom. Choose a directed bloom, a thorn lattice, or shelter petals.

HeroList.Name: Patchwork Host
HeroList.Description: All ordinary companion themes may appear. Enemy health +12% and count +6% through wave 8, rising to +35% / +20% at wave 20. Rerolls cost 1 less gold.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Choose one permanent friend as the featured performer in the shop. Four of its basic attacks or contact hits let you perform a weapon-shaped imitation, at most once per 3s. Supportive friends add a small healing encore. Choose an exact act, a duet, or a wide stage. A missing lead is replaced automatically; no friend is consumed.

HeroList.Name: Archive Curator
HeroList.Description: Shops offer memory companions. Buying one absorbs its support trait instead of adding a body; your last two memories fight beside you as paper exhibits. Each memory makes enemies 2% tougher (max 12%). Your positive personal modifiers are 25% stronger.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Basic hits record up to three enemy species and their attack styles. Every 6s, replay their shapes against the dream: charging lines, ranged volleys, or close strikes. Choose to update the newest page, preserve your first specimens, or favor new species. Absorbed friend passives remain a separate collection.

HeroList.Name: Tin Virtuoso
HeroList.Description: Your shots cannot split. Allies fire only in response to your critical attacks, with their own weapon damage and a short cooldown. Start with +10% critical chance and 2 projectiles.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Your basic attacks conduct the score; critical attacks count twice. Friends use their equipped weapons normally; a completed phrase also guarantees a response instead of relying on another random roll. Solo needs 2 beats and one performer; Duet needs 4 and two; Tutti needs 6 and up to four. All responses share one damage budget.

HeroList.Name: Lantern Weaver
HeroList.Description: Every fourth attack stitches three nearby enemies with a delayed lantern thread. The thread shares one damage budget.
HeroList.SkillDescription: Basic hits pin up to three living targets. Every fourth attack closes the network, sharing damage over its links. Choose a closed triangle, a stitch toward your position, or a broad seam. Knots last 6s and broken targets are removed; no infinite linked-hit chain.
